scope: P03 first bounded damage/HP extraction batch. Independent source trace and literal expected fixtures only; this report is not compiler, WASM runtime, original-ROM, full-turn or production-engine verification.

fixtureArtifact.method: Hand-selected synthetic battle-stat inputs and literal damage/type/flag results from inspected original functions; independent Python positive-integer arithmetic and tiny Tackle/Water type table checked those values. RNG expected values use unbounded integer multiply/add then explicit modulo2^32. No compiled probe output was consulted.
fixtureArtifact.rejectionProvenance: Expected statuses reflect the explicitly bounded ABI admission contract; unlike positive damage values they are adapter policy, not claimed original-game error codes.

rng.seedDistinction: Original SeedRng accepts u16. Fixture initialState is an internal fullu32 gRngValue assignment/restore, not a claim that SeedRng accepts32 bits. Live seed must be server-controlled.
rng.drawOrdering: The selected post-accuracy/critical-choice kernel calls Random exactly once in ApplyRandomDmgMultiplier, including immune damage0. A full turn has earlier conditional draws and is not covered.

damageSemantics.category: include/battle.h uses type<TYPE_MYSTERY for physical and type>TYPE_MYSTERY for special. Category is by source move type, not a modern per-move category.
damageSemantics.arithmetic: Battle stats are u16; damage/damageHelper are s32. Ratios and divisions truncate at each source operation. Fixtures remain nonnegative and far below signed32 overflow, so independent floor division matches C truncation; negative/overflow behavior is not validated here.
damageSemantics.neutralFormula: floor(floor(adjustedAttack * power * (floor(2*level/5)+2) / adjustedDefense)/50), then branch modifiers and final+2.
damageSemantics.critical: Critical multiplier1/2 is supplied. On critical2, ignore attacker negative/neutral relevant stage and defender positive/neutral relevant stage; retain beneficial attack rises/defense drops. Cmd_damagecalc multiplies returned base by supplied critical and script damage multiplier.
damageSemantics.burn: Physical branch halves the pre+2 intermediate before its minimum1 clamp. Special branch does not apply this burn reduction.
damageSemantics.minimumDifference: Physical zero intermediate is clamped1 then final+2 -> base3. Special zero intermediate goes directly to final+2 -> base2.
damageSemantics.stab: After critical scaling, multiply damage15 then divide10 when either attacker type matches, once only.
damageSemantics.typeOrder: Iterate original type relationships in table order. Process duplicate defender types once. Water/Grass resistance precedes Water/Rock weakness: base7 withoutSTAB becomes3 then6, even when defender type1Rock/type2Grass; a single net multiplier would incorrectly preserve7.
damageSemantics.typeMinimum: After any nonzero relationship multiplier, a rounded zero becomes1. Zero multiplier remains immune0.
damageSemantics.foresight: Target STATUS2_FORESIGHT stops table at TYPE_FORESIGHT marker before Normal/Ghost and Fighting/Ghost immunities.
damageSemantics.random: Drawupper16; percentage100-(draw%16). Multiply current nonzero damage by percentage, divide100, clamp rounded zero1. Immune zero remains0 but consumes the draw.
damageSemantics.zeroDefense: A synthetic defense1 with stage0 reduces to0. Adapter must reject before source division, not execute a WASM integer-division trap.

hpAndControllerEvents.ordering: Original healthbar update request occurs before original HP-data update request. Immediate host acknowledgement replaces native presentation waits for this experiment.
hpAndControllerEvents.healthbar: Signed16 presentation request is raw damage capped10000; it is not capped by currentHP.
hpAndControllerEvents.commit: For supported positive damage, hpDealt=min(damage,currentHP), targetHP=max(0,currentHP-damage), and source physical or special damage history records actualHPdealt.
hpAndControllerEvents.immunity: MOVE_RESULT_NO_EFFECT prevents HP/controller events. Source no-effect bookkeeping marks special-status dmg0xFFFF; hpDealt and physical/special damage records remain zero in a reset case.
hpAndControllerEvents.limit: HP reaching0 is not proof of faint processing, replacement choice, victory, loss, experience, ownership or durable outcomes.

originalAttackPipeline.note: Batch1 selects only damage/type/random and HP-update work; it does not execute this entire script or its earlier RNG/PP behavior.

remainingDependencies.coupling: Commands inspect gBattleControllerExecFlags and return while controllers work. They use gBattlescriptCurrInstr and script stacks; move animations, messages and HP writes emit controller requests. Full extraction needs an explicit event/ack/scheduling boundary.

Held-item lookups, Enigma Berry data, badge flags/player side, battle flags, ability field queries, weather, party-alive counts and gBattleResources flags affect arithmetic. Batch1 may answer only explicitly absent capabilities; unexpected queries must fail rather than silently supply defaults.

gBattleMons, gCurrentMove, gBattleMoveDamage, gBattleMovePower, gCritMultiplier, gMoveResultFlags, gBattlerAttacker/Target, gStatuses3, gProtectStructs, gSpecialStatuses, gBattleStruct, gBattleResources, gBattleScripting and gRngValue need isolated instances or complete per-battle context. Original pointers/controller buffers are not a durable snapshot format.

Status/action cancellation, ability/item effects, secondary effects, switching, end-of-turn processing and faint/victory/loss remain necessary batch2 work. Seeded damage alone does not close battle mechanics.

Versioned create/validate/advance/snapshot/restore/project contract, ordered stable events and domain effect identities remain distinct from native globals. Persistence, protocol projection and live RNG secrecy require separate verification.

decisionBoundary: This evidence can support batch1 observations only. P03 success and ADR-001 selection require the remaining representative mechanics, two interleaved battles, deterministic replay/snapshot-restore, Node integration and measured resources without shared-state contamination.
